Aaron, saw ASI secured a growth investment from Incline Equity and acquired CSI's iMIS product suite.

A growth round plus a new product line usually opens more strategic accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Aaron, quick follow-up for ASI.

With new backing, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late, and by then it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ASI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Aaron, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
